title: Notice the Bedtime Step That Worked | Parenting Rewind
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: Bedtime can include complaints and cooperation in the same few minutes. Focusing only on the complaint may hide the moment a six-year-old actually put on pajamas or climbed into bed. Pause and name the useful action without pretending the whole evening was easy. Try: You felt upset about stopping play, and you still put on your pajamas when the timer ended. Specific praise helps the child recognize the exact bedtime skill they used and can practice again tomorrow.
